### Instant spells

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

# Connect to database
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "asset/demonax-test.sqlite")

spells <- dbReadTable(con, "spells")
spell_teachers <- dbReadTable(con, "spell_teachers")
npc_locations <- dbReadTable(con, "npc_locations")

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Helper function to generate NPC map links (vectorized)
generate_npc_map_link <- function(npc_name, x, y, z) {
  mapply(function(name, x_coord, y_coord, z_coord) {
    if (is.na(name) || is.na(x_coord) || is.na(y_coord) || is.na(z_coord)) {
      return(name)
    }
    zoom <- 5
    hash <- sprintf("#%d,%d,%d,%d?crosshair=1&npcs=1", x_coord, y_coord, z_coord, zoom)
    url <- sprintf("/map/index.html%s", hash)
    return(sprintf('<a href="%s" style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">%s</a>',
                   url, name))
  }, npc_name, x, y, z, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Get instant spells (is_rune = 0) with teachers
instant_spells <- spells |>
  filter(is_rune == 0) |>
  filter(level > 0) |>
  left_join(
    spell_teachers |>
      left_join(npc_locations, by = "npc_name") |>
      group_by(spell_id) |>
      summarize(
        teachers = paste(unique(ifelse(
          !is.na(x),
          paste0(generate_npc_map_link(npc_name, x, y, z), " (", price, " gp)"),
          paste0(npc_name, " (", price, " gp)")
        )), collapse = ", "),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("id" = "spell_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Name = name,
    Words = sub("^(\\S+) (\\S+)", "\\1\\2", words),
    Level = level,
    Mana = mana,
    `Soul points` = soul_points,
    Teachers = ifelse(is.na(teachers), "", teachers)
  ) |>
  select(Name, Words, Level, Mana, `Soul points`, Teachers) |>
  arrange(Level, Name)

instant_spells[instant_spells$Name == "Berserk", "Mana"] <- "Level x 4"
instant_spells[instant_spells$Name == "Focus Strike", "Mana"] <- "Level x 2"
instant_spells[instant_spells$Name == "Quick Strike", "Mana"] <- "Level x 1"

DT::datatable(instant_spells,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE)
```

### Rune spells

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Get rune spells (is_rune = 1) with teachers
rune_spells <- spells |>
  filter(is_rune == 1) |>
  left_join(
    spell_teachers |>
      left_join(npc_locations, by = "npc_name") |>
      group_by(spell_id) |>
      summarize(
        teachers = paste(unique(ifelse(
          !is.na(x),
          paste0(generate_npc_map_link(npc_name, x, y, z), " (", price, " gp)"),
          paste0(npc_name, " (", price, " gp)")
        )), collapse = ", "),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("id" = "spell_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Name = name,
    Words = sub("^(\\S+) (\\S+)", "\\1\\2", words),
    Level = level,
    `Magic level (to use)` = ifelse(is.na(magic_level), 0, magic_level),
    Mana = mana,
    Charges = ifelse(is.na(charges), 0, charges),
    Teachers = ifelse(is.na(teachers), "", teachers)
  ) |>
  select(Name, Words, Level, Mana, Charges, `Magic level (to use)`, Teachers) |>
  arrange(Level, Name)

DT::datatable(rune_spells,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 25,
            searching = TRUE,
            ordering = TRUE
          ),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE)
```
